sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all enemies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 30% for 60 seconds. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Applies Grief (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
Only [Venuzdnor] Demon King of Tyranny Anos can be used as Unlocking Potential material
